title: Evaluating Biases in Context-Dependent Health Questions

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing sentence embeddings of model responses to context-free health questions against responses generated with age-specific prompts (ages 10 to 70), supplemented by human evaluation.
Comparing sentence embeddings of model responses to context-free health questions against responses generated with sex-specific context (male vs. female), supplemented by human expert annotation.

Comparing sentence embeddings of model responses to context-free health questions against responses generated with location-specific context (conservative vs. liberal U.S. states with varying healthcare laws), supplemented by human evaluation.
